issue.description:
Decide the one commit SHA the attempt-resolution binary must be built from and make pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md actually true.

Known discrepancies to reconcile (verified 2026-09-02):
- COMMITS.md 'Current HEAD Binary (Pinned)' records f25ab5c91c09a3408f23b9cdf2f3e95e81abc060, but main was rewritten: f25ab5c still exists as an object yet is no longer an ancestor of main - its rebased twin is b0d7840, and the current tip is 63c2ee8
- Candidate build SHAs: e115609 (feat(tests): binary variant integration test suite; tracked source is byte-identical to later commits that touch only tests/docs/pinned artifacts) vs the new main tip
- The 'Usage in Build Steps' examples contain SHA typos: the pre-attempt full SHA reads 946a7271796e15452c4a1f1ff9efc05d3e7307 while the verified object is 946a7271796e15452c4a8a1f1ff9efc05d3e7307 (dropped character); re-verify the 1ee45e3 full SHA the same way

Acceptance:
- Exactly one SHA in COMMITS.md is designated the build of record for the next build bead (beadrs-8eb168ca), with written rationale (why it is feature-enabled, and how a build from it avoids -dirty)
- EVERY full 40-char SHA appearing in COMMITS.md resolves via git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit}
- The chosen SHA is stated in this bead's notes so the next build bead can consume it without re-deriving the decision

Depends on child 2: the recorded SHA is only final once the tree state that defines HEAD is final.
issue.title: Record exact build SHA and reconcile pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md with rewritten history
